say:1:1631006001:1.text: Hmm... yeah, I guess so! It's not as cute as my plushies, but it's still fun!
say:1:1631006001:1.source_cn: 嗯……算是吧，它虽然没有我的玩偶那么可爱，但很有意思！
say:1:1631006001:1.male: Hmm... yeah, I guess so! It's not as cute as my plushies, but it's still fun!
say:1:1631006001:1.female: Hmm... yeah, I guess so! It's not as cute as my plushies, but it's still fun!

say:2:1631006002:1.text: I've got a sharp eye, too! I used to win against Mom and Dad all the time.
say:2:1631006002:1.source_cn: 我的眼力可好了，我和爸爸妈妈一起玩牌的时候，每次我都能...
say:2:1631006002:1.male: I've got a sharp eye, too! I used to win against Mom and Dad all the time.
say:2:1631006002:1.female: I've got a sharp eye, too! I used to win against Mom and Dad all the time.

say:3:1631006003:1.text: But they've been really busy with work lately... they haven't played with me in a while.
say:3:1631006003:1.source_cn: 不过最近他们工作好忙，都没时间陪我了……
say:3:1631006003:1.male: But they've been really busy with work lately... they haven't played with me in a while.
say:3:1631006003:1.female: But they've been really busy with work lately... they haven't played with me in a while.

say:4:1631006004:1.text: So... thank you for playing with me today.
say:4:1631006004:1.source_cn: 谢谢你愿意和我一起玩。
say:4:1631006004:1.male: So... thank you for playing with me today.
say:4:1631006004:1.female: So... thank you for playing with me today.
